home.Welcome: Hot Tacos welcomes you to Leamington and Windsor, Ontario! With four years of support from the Latin and Canadian communities, a variety of dishes for an authentic Mexican experience, and rapid growth, we are the number one Mexican restaurant. Discover why we are the favorite among Mexican food lovers!
